purpose: Authorized virtual-adapter MuJoCo observation-layout preflight for one SO-101. It freezes a candidate model and virtual cameras for one run, while treating real-hardware calibration as a later adjustment and not as a simulated fact.

simulator.name: MuJoCo
simulator.version: resolved at environment installation and recorded in the immutable run manifest
simulator.model_asset_sha256: resolved immediately before execution and recorded in the immutable run manifest
simulator.pinning_rule: The selected model, resolved MuJoCo version, source revision and asset SHA-256 are fixed within a run. A future run may use a revised model or calibrated cameras only as a new run, never by changing this run's evidence.

scene.actuation: disabled; the arm remains at a recorded safe static pose
scene.physical_safety: simulation only; no command may be sent to hardware

sensors.extrinsics: derived from the frozen candidate model only; virtual only

sensors.intrinsics: virtual nominal configuration; not a physical-camera calibration
sensors.extrinsics: virtual nominal configuration; not a physical-camera calibration

sensors.intrinsics: virtual nominal configuration; not a physical-camera calibration
sensors.extrinsics: virtual nominal configuration; not a physical-camera calibration

protocol.object_pose_generation: deterministic sampler in a horizontal disk whose radius is 0.5 times the seed-0, 10,000-joint-sample estimate of the candidate model's maximum radial gripper-site reach from its baseframe; this is a virtual-only conservative workspace definition
record_per_episode: cup visibility label from simulator geometry

metrics: repeated-render hash equality for identical seed and pinned runtime
non_claims: No grasp, IK, collision, load, physical calibration, perception, control, sim-to-real, or multi-robot capability is evaluated.
Virtual camera intrinsics/extrinsics and sampled reach are deliberately adaptable inputs for later runs; they are not claims about the hardware.
Simulator geometry labels are evaluation metadata only and must not be passed to a future runtime perception component.
